answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 26594 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it ok for a girl to wear chouridar pajama(tight pajama)in front of mehrams with a long shirt upto knees over it and is it ok to wear short sleeves in front of mehrams? Question: is it ok for a girl to wear chouridar pajama(tight pajama)in front of mehrams with a long shirt upto knees over it and is it ok to wear short sleeves in front of mehrams? Answer ID: 26594 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1585/1585/M=1431) There is no harm in wearing the said dress in front of the mahram men provided there is no fear of fitna . However, Muslim women should avoid wearing such tight clothes that expose the figure of body or a dress worn by fashionable and impious women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
